🌊 Beachfront Plot for Sale | Kidoti, Nungwi – Zanzibar

An extraordinary and once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to own a massive beachfront plot in one of Zanzibar's most breathtaking and secluded coastal locations.

📍 Kidoti, Nungwi – just 9km from Nungwi town center
🛣️ Only 3 minutes' drive to the main road
📐 Total Land: 11,500 sqm (100m × 115m)
🏖️ 100 meters of direct beach frontage — your own slice of paradise
🪸 Coral rock terrain — ideal for unique over-water and ocean-facing construction (think over-water villas, rooms extending into the sea, ocean-view suites)
🏝️ Islands facing the plot — offering stunning and uninterrupted ocean views
🚗 Less than 10 minutes to Nungwi Beach & Kendwa Beach
💵 Asking Price: $1,200,000 USD (Negotiable)


Imagine waking up every morning to the sound of the Indian Ocean right at your doorstep. With 100 meters of beachfront, coral rock terrain, and islands right in front of you — this is truly a one-of-a-kind plot. Perfect for a luxury resort, boutique hotel, private estate, or a high-return investment development.

This is the last plot of this size available in this area. Opportunities like this do not come twice.

articles.title: Complete Guide to Buying Land in Zanzibar
articles.excerpt: Buying land in Zanzibar is a great opportunity for both local buyers and foreign investors. Zanzibar offers strong ...
articles.content:
Buying land in Zanzibar is a great opportunity for both local buyers and foreign investors. Zanzibar offers strong economic growth, beautiful landscapes, and a growing real estate market.

Whether you are looking for beachfront property, agricultural land, or urban plots, Zanzibar has a wide variety of options. The process of buying land involves working with the Zanzibar Investment Promotion Authority (ZIPA) and the Ministry of Land.

articles.title: How ZIPA Approval Works for Foreign Property Investors
articles.excerpt: Zanzibar is one of the most attractive destinations for foreign property investors. Its growing tourism industry, s ...
articles.content:
Zanzibar is one of the most attractive destinations for foreign property investors. The Zanzibar Investment Promotion Authority (ZIPA) is the government body that facilitates and regulates foreign investment on the island.

To invest in real estate as a foreigner, you must obtain a Certificate of Incentives from ZIPA.

articles.content: Zanzibar is a beautiful island destination that offers more than just holidays. It is a place where you can enjoy a unique blend of culture, history, and natural beauty while also exploring excellent property investment opportunities.
